text.text: Othello Multivision was a Japanese home video game console released in 1983 by Tsukuda Original. It was a licensed clone of Sega's SG-1000 and used compatible cartridges, allowing it to play many SG-1000 games. The system was named after the board game Othello and was bundled with the game, but its compatibility with Sega software gave it a wider library. As one of the early SG-1000-compatible systems, it represents the variety of Japanese consoles competing during the second generation of home gaming.
